answer: A locksmith guild membership is the credential: a membership the guild renews after vetted lock work. The registry is consulted again every epoch, and a record that does not match the issuer's own books ends the seat. The vertex signal separates the two cases at a glance: Each of 260 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The juniper ledger records each payment, the beacon window resets the board, and 260 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
